title: Hidden-retention scaling test runs the quadratic reference loop on every gate
outcome: The default test suite no longer spends seconds timing the old O(hidden × (delegations + sessions)) reference loop, and the linear-cost property of retain_hidden_source_observation_sessions is guarded by a checkable work-unit count instead of printed timings.
acceptance: hidden_retention_pass_scaling_is_printed_for_diagnosis no longer runs the reference loop at ~8,400 sessions in the default suite
a test asserts a bounded operation count for the indexed pass, without elapsed-time thresholds
